title: Mar bar Pupidata of Pumbedita
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Eruvin 60a, Rav Yosef sends Abaye to arrange an eruv for the people of Kakunai. Abaye recalls the straw storehouse belonging to Mar bar Pupidata of Pumbedita that was used as the portion excluded from Pumbedita’s eruv. From this Hyman infers that he was a rabbinic scholar in Abaye’s time.

notes.text: Shiyur is the portion left outside the communal eruv, not shiur, a measurement. The scholarly status and dating are Hyman’s inference from the narrative.
